name: fashion-store
description: A full-stack fashion eCommerce platform with a cinematic storefront, AI-assisted shopping, a retail-grade admin dashboard, and a hardened Express/Prisma API. The project is built as two deployable apps: a Next.js frontend and a Node.js backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
